name: Lat Pulldown
common_faults: leaning too far back converting to a row
not reaching full elbow extension at the top

substitutions.note: bodyweight; no load scalability; higher systemic demand

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded elbow flexion overhead
resistance_profile: constant cable tension; hardest when arms are overhead; decreases as bar approaches chest

provenance.notes: Scalable alternative to pull-ups. Grip width, attachment, and angle alter lat vs bicep emphasis. SFR heuristic.
